steps.speaker: Crazed ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Shackles... Shackles...

steps.speaker: Crazed ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You know... nothing yet...
Before the remaining phantom finishes, Hella swings her pipe and breaks it apart.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: A mere impostor, and you want me, Hella, to be scared?! I'm not even afraid of the real thing!
She turns to you and surveys you as if making sure you're real. It takes a while before she pounces on you with a scream.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You troublemaking ************! I'm so angry! Don't ever run off without me again!
She taps your head and whines. At that moment, a yellow-haired girl charges at you and hugs your waist.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Oh—Ch—ief...!!!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: I'm so glad you're fine, do you know how worried I was, don't run off again, I'll protect you, don't leave me again ahhhhhh!!!

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: Hmph, her mouth is the first part of her that recovers. This would have been much easier if the Archer Queen's arrows were as powerful as her words.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Sigh. It doesn't matter. What matters is that Master is not hurt.
She walks up and takes your hand. Her cold mechanical body is actually trembling, and there's a rare warmth in her tone.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Thank you. You're still here...
What happened to the artificial maid? You are about to ask when you look up and see Hecate's smiling face.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, it's time for us to get on board.

options: ...Thank you for coming to get me.

steps.content: What a touching reunion, but don't forget that the Witching Hour isn't over yet.
Don't stay too long near the Gate of Hell. It's dangerous...

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: The voice... Are you...?
A woman comes from the darkness with a delicate hammer. She swings it at the dark Gate of Hell...
The gate shatters with a bang, and light shines in, illuminating the woman in blue.

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: ...Why did you destroy it? Isn't that the work you're proud of?

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: Enfer?
The woman in blue turns back with a smile.
Obsidian pieces fall, and the light shines through the broken Gate of Hell, revealing a deeper space.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Yes. I created every piece here, and I'm the only one who can put them to rest. And...

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: As Sinners, there's no way for us to fight the shackles, right?
She turns to you, and in the crowd's astonishment, gently interlocks her fingers with yours. Between your palms, the shackles faintly resonate.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: All right. Please follow me. The culprit is behind this gate, and I have opened the way for you.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: You defeated my masterpiece and put me in shackles. I will have to fulfill your wish and end the Witching Hour.
